text:
Mira Patel: quick heads-up – noticed hosted spend for acct 'novum-inc' spiked 3x vs our weekly commit starting yesterday afternoon.
Samir Khan: saw that too, Mira. any pattern on which endpoints or keys?
Mira Patel: mostly /v1/generate, high token counts (> 20k) per req from a small set of api keys.
Jordan Lee: could be a runaway test harness. @Priya Rao can you check if they're on sandbox vs prod keys?
Priya Rao: digging in now. dashboard link: https://redwood.internal/cs/novum-inc/spend (private)
BillingBot: Alert: account=novum-inc threshold_exceeded=commit_weekly burn_rate=3.2x timestamp=1962345678
Mira Patel: @Jordan can you pull a quick breakdown by client_id? if it's a few clients we can throttle.
Jordan Lee: running query:
```
SELECT client_id, SUM(tokens) AS tokens_total
FROM billing.events
WHERE account = 'novum-inc' AND ts >= '2026-03-18'
GROUP BY client_id
ORDER BY tokens_total DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
Jordan Lee: top 2 client_ids account for 91% of the extra tokens.
Samir Khan: ok let's put temporary soft cap 100k tokens/hr on those keys and notify the customer.
Priya Rao: i'll email the CSM with suggested mitigation and ask for confirmation before enforcing hard cut.
Mira Patel: also flag for follow-up on onboarding: confirm they didn't misconfigure a QA script; note renewal at risk if this repeats.
EngOps Bot: Action created: OP-4521 throttle-rule + customer-notify assigned=Samir Khan due=2026-03-24
Samir Khan: will implement soft cap in 10m and circle back with logs.
Priya Rao: thanks — if anyone sees latency or 5xx spike post-throttle ping in #incidents.
Mira Patel: good catch team :thumbsup:
